181: Jerry Maguire used to be a typical sports agent: willing to do just about anything he could to get the biggest possible contracts for his clients, plus a nice commission for himself. 437: A high school teacher meets his match in an over-achieving student politician.

The old west meets the far east.

NO NEED TO FEAR.. UNDERDOG IS HERE!

the few, the proud, the paroled.

He's a dreamer, stuck in the real world.

Dreaded Megalon from the undersea kingdom! A miraculous deathblow from the wound-ridden Godzilla!

She comes back for the last child.

Some distractions are better than others.

Like nothing you've ever seen before!

Yi Yue, chef de la cavalerie de Liang

We fight to end this fate.

Khairil Fikri bin Abdul Musa / Ustat
